one_liner.zh: 加密与传统同向 risk-off：BTC 窗口 -4.5% 高位震荡、杠杆中性，高实现波动下期权相对 RV 折价，现货 ETF 通道强流出（BTC 净 -12.82 亿美金）。
one_liner.en: Crypto and TradFi in sync risk-off: BTC -4.5% in high-level chop with neutral leverage; high realized vol but options cheap vs RV; spot ETF channel in strong outflow (BTC net -1.28B).

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 -12.82 亿美金

risk.zh: 风险在于高位震荡叠加强流出与 VIX 急升，若出清未充分而波动继续抬升，中性杠杆也可能快速拥挤转向。
risk.en: Risk sits in high chop plus strong outflows and a VIX spike: if clearance is incomplete while vol keeps rising, neutral leverage can flip crowded fast.

watch.zh: 盯强流出是否延续、IV-RV 折价能否收窄，以及清算峰后 OI 与资金费率是否仍保持中性。
watch.en: Watch whether strong outflows persist, if the IV-RV discount narrows, and whether OI plus funding stay neutral after the liquidation peak.

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏便宜（IV 相对 RV 折价）

compare.zh: BTC 窗口收益 -4.47%，ETH 更深至 -6.50%；美股括号内 ES -2.78%、NQ -5.08%，黄金 +4.51%，美元指数小幅 +0.41%。加密与股指同向回撤，风险偏好同步降温，黄金则走出独立避险色。
compare.en: BTC window return -4.47%, ETH deeper at -6.50%; in the US bracket ES -2.78%, NQ -5.08%, gold +4.51%, DXY +0.41%. Crypto and equities pulled back together as risk appetite cooled in sync, while gold showed a separate safe-haven tone.

path.zh: 路径标签为高位震荡：全周并未单边崩塌，而是在相对高位反复消化，收于 -4.5% 附近；11-05 附近波动与清算更密，随后价格仍未脱离震荡框架。
path.en: Path labeled high-level chop: no one-way collapse, instead repeated digestion at elevated levels, finishing near -4.5%; volatility and liquidations clustered around 11-05, yet price stayed inside the chop framework.

leverage.zh:
标签：杠杆中性。
① 拥挤线（OI + 资金费率年化）：周初约 +10.95%/yr → 期末约 +6.27%/yr，租金全周降温；OI 周变约 +0.36%（95252 → 95595），全周库存仅略变——更像摩擦期，而非匀速大拆/大堆杠杆。
② 出清线（OI + 清算）：主峰日 11-05（2026-11-05）；峰值约 2.35× 周内中位清算量；价格同日约 -5.5%；当日 OI 约 94172；但 OI 周高在 2026-11-02（约 99012），峰值日并非双高；峰值日 OI 较前一日下降，偏出清/去库存与清算同日。次日 2026-11-06：OI 约 96387、funding 年化约 +10.95%/yr、价格约 -0.3%。
③ 量旁证（永续成交额=活跃度）：周合计约 788.41 亿美金，环比约 +4.6%，活跃度中性；量侧用于核对热闹程度，不拆多空。
收句：拥挤线与出清线并读 → 清算峰相对中位偏温和、峰值日并非 OI 周高（无「清算∥OI 双高」）、量旁证偏淡，共同支撑「杠杆中性」；禁止把清算/OI/funding 写成涨跌原因。
leverage.en:
Label: leverage_neutral.
① Crowding (OI + funding ann.): ~+10.95%/yr → ~+6.27%/yr — rent cooled over the week; OI week change ~+0.36% (95252 → 95595), inventory barely moved — friction week, not steady build/unwind.
② Flush (OI + liquidations): peak day 2026-11-05; peak ~2.35× median liq qty; price that day ~-5.5%; OI that day ~94172; OI week-high was 2026-11-02 (~99012), not a dual-high peak day; OI down vs prior day — flush/de-stocking with liquidations. Next day 2026-11-06: OI ~96387; funding ~+10.95%/yr; price ~-0.3%.
③ Volume side (perp turnover = activity): week sum ~78.84B, WoW ~+4.6%, activity normal; activity only, not long/short.
Close: crowding + flush lines → liq peak mild vs median; peak day ≠ OI week-high (no liq∥OI dual-high); volume side quieter — supports “leverage_neutral”; do not write liq/OI/funding as the cause of price.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎 -12.82 亿美金（强流出，4 日流出、1 日流入，单日最深约 -4.30 亿在 11-05）；ETH ETF 净 -3.65 亿美金。并陈 Binance 现货成交额周合计 81.37 亿美金、环比约持平（-0.06%），总量热闹度正常，不与净流加总、不拆多空。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETF aggregate net -1.28B (strong outflow: 4 outflow days, 1 inflow, deepest day about -430M on 11-05); ETH ETF net -365.20M. Alongside, Binance spot turnover summed 8.14B on the week, roughly flat WoW (-0.06%)—normal activity level; do not sum with net flow or split long/short.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 81.37 亿美金，相对上完整周 -0.1%（活跃度「中性」；上周约 81.42 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-11-05（20.25 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 788.41 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 8.14B, vs prior full week -0.1% (activity “normal”; prior ~8.14B). Peak day 2026-11-05 (2.03B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (78.84B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 高 RV 搭配 IV 折价，意味着市场已付出较大实际波动，但期权定价尚未同步抬升保护溢价；在震荡周里，这种「波动已发生、保险仍便宜」的错位往往比单纯涨跌更值得记录。
vol_teach.en: High RV with IV discount means sizable realized moves already occurred while option pricing has not fully lifted the protection premium; in a chop week this “vol already paid, insurance still cheap” gap is often more notable than the bare return.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 55.31%（高实现波动），期末 Deribit IV 约 40.99%，IV-RV 点差 -14.32，期权相对 RV 明显折价；ETH 端 RV 更高约 87.87%、IV 约 57.97%，折价结构类似。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~55.31% ann (high), end Deribit IV ~40.99%, IV-RV spread -14.32—options clearly cheap vs RV; ETH similar structure with higher RV ~87.87% and IV ~57.97%.

vol_combo.zh: 高实现波动 + 期权偏便宜 + 杠杆中性同时出现：价格在高位来回扫，杠杆未明显加码，波动却已抬升，IV 仍落后于 RV，形成「波动先行、定价与仓位滞后」的组合。
vol_combo.en: High realized vol + cheap options + neutral leverage together: price sweeps at elevated levels, leverage not clearly added, yet vol has risen while IV still lags RV—a “vol first, pricing and positioning lag” combo.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格周跌约 4.5% 的同时 IV 收在 41% 附近、相对 55% RV 折价；下跌并未触发 IV 急贵，反而维持便宜状态，与「恐慌推升期权」的经典路径不一致。
vol_price_iv.en: Price down ~4.5% while IV ended near 41% and cheap vs 55% RV; the decline did not force IV rich—it stayed discounted, diverging from the classic “panic lifts options” path.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 窗口约 +32%，与加密高 RV、同向 risk-off 一致；传统波动标尺抬头时，BTC 的 IV 却仍相对 RV 折价，跨市场波动传导并未完整映射到加密期权端。
vol_vix.en: VIX ~+32% on its window, aligned with crypto high RV and sync risk-off; yet BTC IV remained cheap vs RV, so cross-market vol transmission did not fully map onto crypto options.

what.zh: 美股隐含波动指数 VIX

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元走强时对风险资产偏逆风。
vs_crypto.en: Stronger USD is often a headwind for risk assets.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与币关系需看结构，不宜硬套。
vs_crypto.en: Link to crypto is structural—not mechanical.

tradfi_summary.zh: 美股括号（10-30～11-06）ES、NQ 同步回撤，VIX 大幅抬升，美债 10Y 收益率下行约 7bp，美元小涨、黄金明显走强；整体是风险资产承压、避险与波动标尺升温的 risk-off 周，与加密同向。
tradfi_summary.en: US bracket (10-30–11-06): ES and NQ both retreated, VIX rose sharply, US10Y yield down ~7 bp, dollar slightly up, gold clearly stronger—a risk-off week of pressured risk assets and hotter vol/safe-haven gauges, in sync with crypto.

three_conclusions.zh: 本周核心矛盾是「高实现波动 + 期权仍便宜」叠「现货 ETF 强流出」：价格与股指同向 risk-off，但 IV 未跟 RV 同步变贵。
three_conclusions.en: Core tension: high realized vol + still-cheap options stacked on strong spot-ETF outflows—price risk-off in sync with equities, yet IV did not richen with RV.

three_conclusions.zh: 杠杆保持中性（OI 近乎持平、资金费率温和），11-05 清算峰未演化成持续双高，量能正常，仓位层未出现极端拥挤信号。
three_conclusions.en: Leverage stayed neutral (OI nearly flat, funding mild); the 11-05 liq peak did not become sustained dual highs, volume normal—no extreme crowding signal in positioning.

three_conclusions.zh: 现货通道本周是强流出主叙事之一（BTC -12.82 亿），与高位震荡、同向回撤并陈；现货成交额持平，热闹度未同步放大。
three_conclusions.en: Spot channel was a lead strong-outflow story (BTC -1.28B), set beside high chop and sync pullback; spot turnover flat, so activity heat did not expand in parallel.

text.zh: ETF 强流出是否在下一周延续或翻转为净流入（对照 BTC 净流与流出天数）。
text.en: Whether ETF strong outflow persists or flips to net inflow next week (check BTC net and outflow-day count).

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周通道已标强流出且幅度显著大于上周，是最需要下期核对的姿态变化。

text.zh: IV 相对 RV 的折价（约 -14 点差）是否收窄，或 IV 仍明显落后于实现波动。
text.en: Whether the IV-vs-RV discount (~-14 pts) narrows, or IV remains clearly behind realized vol.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 高 RV 下期权仍便宜是本周独特错位，收窄与否直接关系到波动定价是否补课。

text.zh: 高位震荡是否打破：价格能否脱离本周震荡区间，或继续以中性杠杆消化。
text.en: Whether high-level chop breaks: price leaves this week’s range, or keeps digesting under neutral leverage.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 趋势标签仍是高位震荡且匹配均值回归，下期需验证震荡框架是否被趋势力量替代。

matched.zh: 匹配 mean_reversion：高位震荡、杠杆中性、强流出与同向 risk-off 下价格来回消化而非单边趋势延伸，均值回归逻辑比追趋势更贴合本周结构。
matched.en: Matched mean_reversion: high chop, neutral leverage, strong outflows and sync risk-off produced two-way digestion rather than one-way trend extension, so mean-reversion logic fits the week’s structure better than trend chase.

mismatched.zh: 错配 trend_following 与 vol_harvest：趋势未清晰延伸（高位震荡收负），且高 RV 下 IV 折价使单纯卖波动收获的安全垫变薄，两者均与本周标签相悖。
mismatched.en: Mismatched trend_following and vol_harvest: trend did not cleanly extend (high chop finished negative), and IV cheapness under high RV thins the cushion for plain vol-selling—both clash with this week’s labels.

why.en: Trend reads choppy/grind (chop_high); closer to range-bound than one-way trend. Wide high-vol chop is still rough for reversion-style paths.
